title: (CMDE) Cat Music Disc Extended
description: This project changes the cat music disc file to be like the Xbox 360 Edition cat music disc.
body:
**This resource pack changes the _Cat_ music disc file to include _Dog_ by _C418_, like it did in the Xbox 360 Edition.**

## # **Issues in versions** :

**1.0-commandrun**: Requires command to play the full song.

Input all other issues in the Discord server.

[VirusTotal Scan](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/8f9748dbe205d9e76b0079652d2e239c5b910960abbfc372b0b364ceda6a281b?nocache=1)
